item.title: Hill, Moore speed to top-4 times in 40-yard dash at NFL Combine
item.description: Hill has the highest draft grade of any Longhorn, as evaluated by NFL.com draft analysts, and he ran the third-fastest time of all the linebackers at 4.51 seconds. Ohio State's Sonny Styles led the position with a 4.46, followed by TCU's Kaleb Alarms-Orr at 4.47.

item.title: Rabid skunk in Buda prompts warning as Hays County sees uptick in cases
item.description: Hays County is seeing an uptick in rabies cases and warning community members to stay alert.

item.title: Austin PD focuses on officers' mental health support
item.description: At the Austin Police Department, a range resources are available to officers both before and after critical incidents.

item.title: Liberty Hill man gets 75 years on child sex abuse charges
item.description: A Liberty Hill man was sentenced to serve 75 years in prison after a Hays County jury found him guilty of continuous sexual abuse of a child.

item.title: Texas school districts approach crucial deadline for prayer policy
item.description: Texas school districts have until Saturday to vote whether they will adopt a resolution that would require each school to provide a period for prayer and reading religious texts for students and staff.

item.title: Wind fades and warmth eases ahead of rain next week
item.description: A much-needed wetter pattern is on track to gradually begin toward the middle of next week. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: Lawmakers say US military used laser to take down Border Protection drone
item.description: The U.S. military used a laser to shoot down a Customs and Border Protection drone, members of Congress said Thursday, and the Federal Aviation Administration responded by closing more airspace near El Paso, Texas. It's not clear why the laser was deployed but it's the second time in two weeks that one has been fired [...]

item.title: Godzilla to destroy Austin, other Texas cities in upcoming anthology
item.description: The King of the Monsters will stomp through Texas on his ceaseless path of destruction in May.

item.title: Austin home builder leaves behind neighborhood of half-finished homes in Georgetown
item.description: Onx Homes Inc., a modular home manufacturer that had received $120 million in investor capital, has left its 204,000-square-foot lease in Georgetown, and several dozen half-built homes in the area.

item.title: Austin approves 'citywide efficiency audit' proposal, independent auditor will run recurring audit
item.description: The proposed "Comprehensive Efficiency Assessment Program" would consist of "assessments designed to address cost effective performance improvements of all other City departments" on a three-year cycle.
